title: Camp Y-Noah's Equestrian Center
specs: Over 25 horses owned by YMCA on site
Over 250 wooded acres with miles of trails for riding
Riders must be at least 8 years old for trail rides; 3 years and up for other programs
Riders must be under 220 pounds for trail rides; under 200 pounds for Family Camp trail rides
Long pants and shoes/boots with a heel required for lessons; long pants suggested for trail rides
All riders must wear ASTM/SEI approved helmets, provided if needed
Physical fitness, flexibility, and balance required for horseback riding; disclose any conditions affecting balance or ability to ride
Cabins sleep up to 14 people; lodges sleep up to 12 or 18 depending on type
Cabin mate requests possible for Women’s Weekend

services.name: Trail Rides
services.desc: Couples, families, or groups--are you looking for a fun day on the trail? YMCA Camp Y-Noah is the place for you. Our guided western style trail rides are for adults and children at least eight years old. Trails wind through miles of beautiful terrain that extend across over 250 wooded acres of Camp Y-Noah. We have trails suitable all types of riders. Depending on the time of your visit, you might be able to enjoy the wonderful wild flowers and a variety of wildlife. Our friendly guides keep an eye on the horses as they answer any questions you may have. Horseback riding is a physical activity that requires physical fitness, flexibility, and balance. blurb: Camp Y-Noah's Equestrian Center offers year-round riding lessons in English and Western styles for beginners to advanced riders, trail rides on over 250 acres, and equestrian-focused overnight and day camps for ages 8-16. Lessons include riding skills, horsemanship, and horse care. Trail rides are guided western style and suitable for riders 8 years and older.
extraNote: $75 non-refundable deposit due upon registration for lessons · Cancellations over 2 weeks before lesson session start get refund minus deposit; no refunds within 2 weeks or no-shows · Lessons cancelled due to extreme weather will be rescheduled · No cash accepted at camp store; use account system with recommended $20-$30 per week · Camp Y-Noah is a nut free facility and accommodates dietary needs if noted on health form · Equestrian Center at 6801 Christman Road · Year-round for lessons; specific dates for camps and events
